name: Send Visee
tagline: A fork of Mozilla's Firefox Send.
description: A fork of Mozilla's Firefox Send. Mozilla discontinued Send, this fork is a community effort to keep the project up-to-date and alive.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-send application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-send-visee
  # The `big-bear-send-visee` service definition
  big-bear-send-visee:
    # Name of the container (Docker does not have to generate a random name)
    container_name: big-bear-send-visee
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: registry.gitlab.com/timvisee/send:v3.4.27@sha256:b950a557f0f4eb7d2114a9126aea5df984ffe868385a3fb6b327d9f770bec0ae
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for the container
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      # Networking
      - BASE_URL=http://${APP_DOMAIN}
      # Redis
      - REDIS_HOST=big-bear-send-visee-redis
      # Storage Limit
      - MAX_FILE_SIZE=2147483648
      # Storage path
      - FILE_DIR=/uploads
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Storage volume
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/uploads:/uploads
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 1443 of the host to port 1443 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:1443"
    networks:
      - big_bear_send_visee_network
  big-bear-send-visee-redis:
    # Name of the container (Docker does not have to generate a random name)
    container_name: big-bear-send-visee-redis
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: redis:8.2.2-alpine@sha256:1c78f5e7512cc8b22b0edc95c20e7abd9e1fd832e5dfd5c3c6b59ce82fb238d0
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis:/data
    # Health check
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
    # Networks to be used for the container
    networks:
      - big_bear_send_visee_network
# Networks to be used for the containers
networks:
  big_bear_send_visee_network:
    # Driver to be used for the network
    driver: bridge
